title: Android RelativeLayout wrap-content child
purpose: Check that a sibling anchored after a wrap-content button moves when the button label changes.
changes: RelativeLayout now uses the child's current measured wrap-content width when resolving sibling anchors.
steps: Find Short and Next under Wrap-content sibling placement. They should appear side by side with a small gap.
Tap Change relative label: Short should become Longer label and grow; Next should move with it and retain the gap. Tap again to restore Short.
Enable Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror and the gap should remain. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The child grows or shrinks with its text and the sibling remains adjacent without overlapping in either direction.
limits: This tests Bhoo's supported wrap-content measurement and anchor rules. Full Android text, theme and RelativeLayout parity remain unverified.
validation: Thirteen Rust RelativeLayout tests passed, including dynamic width, sibling gap and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified dynamic width, sibling gap and RTL placement.
